decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Prior to commencement of construction works, the applicant should provided details of landscaping
to be Approved, this includes landscape masterplan, hard and soft landscape
details.

Soft
landscape works to include:Planting
plans (at a scale not less than 1:100)Schedules
of plants, noting species, plant sizes, plant container sizes (all at time of
planting) and proposed numbers / densities Written
specification of planting and cultivation works to be undertaken A landscape
implementation programme with proposed timing / dates for the works. 
 Hard materials
                                   

 Levels
 




















 Landscaping Scheme – Implementation and implementation programme,
     including a period of 5 year period for replacements of soft landscape

Notwithstanding the approved proposed plans which detail the use of Marshalls Drivesett Tegula Priora block paving in a Harvest colour finish. The applicant shall retain the use of bound gravel on the site.  The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those set out in the approved plans' Schedule of Materials' . The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.
